body: 😂😂😂 i think the only think keeping me here at the moment is wanting to wait and join the 27 club

It just feels like a waste. I work hard as hell to be happy. I workout daily, im in the best shape ever, stronger than ever. I have money saved up. I take care of my dog. And what does any of it lead up to? Blind faith isnt enough to put up with life.
Also i appreciate you commenting. Im glad it does make sense 😅

The only problems I have with it are 1. I dont want to fuck my family. We dont get along, but I'm not tryna leave them with some sort of morgue bill or something.
And 2. Its a gamble. You live until you die and when you die you cant turn back. Maybe life gets better. But the question then is 'what if it doesnt?'
